jobs_results.title: Ruby On Rails Developer
jobs_results.description:
WHO ARE WE ?

FCM Travel is one of the largest and fastest-growing global business travel management companies with a worldwide reach in almost 100 countries. FCM Lab in Barcelona represents a tribe of more than 110 teammates, united by a single mission: developing and ensuring the best services and technology products to support business travellers in their trips around the globe.

See our video () to discover who we are or read more about us at

THE JOB

As a Ruby On Rails Developer, you will create and develop new products for FCM as well as our internal clients.

You will also help to develop or maintain our existing products :
• A tool for travel proposals
• A CRM
• A tool for data analysis
• Some others projects

All of them used across Europe and the world!

OUR TECHNOLOGY

We work with SCRUM methodology and Agile approach. We like Unit testing, Code Reviews, CI/CD and Cloud.

Our current technology stack is:
• Back End : Ruby on Rails (mainly Rails 7.X)
• Frond End : mainly... ReactJS
• Databases : Postgre

SQL and some Mongo

DB, we also have a couple of MySQL and Redis
• Development & production :
Kubernetes, Docker, Git Lab, Digital Ocean
• Event sourcing : Apache Kafka

Our Ideal Candidate ?
• 3 years or more of experience in developing projects with Ruby
• Experience with APIs of different kind
• You are comfortable to work in an international team, in English
• You know how to be both a team player and self-reliant!

WHY FCM SPAIN ?

As well as being a fun company to work :
• We offer our team the choice between working 100% Remote, or in hybrid in a great location in the center of Barcelona
• You have the opportunity to join our free language lessons (English, French, Spanish or Catalan) and some hours for training and self-grow per sprint
• An attractive package: health insurance & tickets to conferences
• 25 days off/year + 5 compensation days + reduced time during summer + bank holidays
• Flexible working-time
• Table tennis on the terrace, a kitchen area with free snacks, fresh fruits and drinks
• The opportunity to work with an international and talented team
• Several activities organised by the ambassadors!

We truly think your personality is important, so bring it on!

️Contract type : Indefinite contract

️ Starting date :
As soon as possible

Location : Plaza Catalunya, Barcelona
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Tech Lead (Ruby on Rails or Javascript) - Remote
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain, Oregon (USA)

Consultora tecnológica especializada en proyectos de Ruby on Rails, Python y JavaScript busca incorporar en su empresa un tech lead encargado de gestionar varios proyectos diferentes en clientes internacionales.

Responsabilidades:
• Liderar equipos de desarrollo en proyectos de Ruby on Rails o JavaScript para clientes internacionales.
• Gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente, garantizando la entrega oportuna y de alta calidad.
• Colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de desarrollo y los stakeholders para comprender los requisitos del proyecto y definir las soluciones técnicas.
• Proporcionar orientación técnica y apoyo al equipo, asegurando la adopción de las mejores prácticas y la implementación eficiente de soluciones.
• Participar activamente en el desarrollo de software, escribiendo código limpio, eficiente y escalable.
• Realizar revisiones de código y asegurar la calidad del código a lo largo del... proceso de desarrollo.
• Mantenerse al día con las últimas tendencias y tecnologías en Ruby on Rails, JavaScript y otros campos relacionados.
• Comunicarse de manera efectiva con los clientes internacionales y el equipo, tanto en español como en inglés.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia sólida como desarrollador en Ruby on Rails o JavaScript.
• Experiencia previa como líder técnico o Tech Lead en proyectos de desarrollo de software.
• Capacidad demostrada para gestionar equipos de desarrollo y múltiples proyectos simultáneamente.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación en español e inglés, tanto verbal como escrita.
• Experiencia trabajando de forma remota y gestionando equipos distribuidos.
• Conocimiento profundo de los principios de diseño de software, arquitectura de sistemas y metodologías ágiles.
• Fuertes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para tomar decisiones técnicas acertadas.
• Pasión por el aprendizaje continuo y el desarrollo profesional.

Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa en proyectos de consultoría tecnológica.

This offer from "Timup" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 75% flex score

jobs_results.title: Ruby on rails developer/senior developer
jobs_results.description:
AppDrawn are looking to recruit a software developer to join our team of developers with experience and passion in development. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced developer with a minimum of 1 years experience. You’ll be working on the full process of the projects from beginning to the end and could get involved in all of the steps of creating the apps. As a boutique web app development company, we have a clear objective: to create innovative and bespoke web apps to elevate businesses. Our primary technology stack is Ruby-on-Rails with ReactJS for web apps and ReactNative for mobile apps.

The role
We are looking for a hard-working member of our team to come on full-time in our office based in central Barcelona.

We are looking for someone who has long-term residency in Barcelona and who is fluent in English.

Essential experience
- Ruby on Rails but other related experience may be accepted
- ReactJS
- HTML/CSS/JS

Desirable skills
- Experience with: Bootstrap... ReactNative, MySQL, Docker, Git

Our ideal candidate will be:
- Honest and straight forward
- Have the ability to adapt to new challenges
- Great at problem solving

What we offer:
- Friendly and supportive team.
- Office in central Barcelona with easy access via public transport.
- Flexible holidays.

Background: AppDrawn is a small but fast-growing web and mobile application development award-winning agency with 22 years of experience. Our core focus is on business applications and bespoke platform development. We currently manage projects from our UK office, serving clients predominantly in the London area. The development team are at Barcelona office. This role would be based in Barcelona.

We have an internal deadline of Friday 3rd June 2022 but we will be interviewing before and after then and so we encourage you to apply asap if you are interested

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer (Ruby on Rails) (Remote, Spain based candidates...
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a Software Engineer to join the team.

➡️ The job

You will join us as a Software Engineer to help us with our platform. We are growing at a fast pace and we also want to build new features and new products? You will have the opportunity to be involved in a lot of things.

We are looking for candidates residing in Spain (we sponsor Visas) to work in Full Remote format. Or if you prefer and live in Barcelona, you can work in a hybrid format in our office.

Onboarding is important for us, so we will make sure you have everything you need to start rocking it!
• In your first month you will land in the company and the team, getting to know the people and the way we work.
• In three months you will be part of the Tech team that has developed this from the very beginning. The development will go smoothly, all the gears will be working, and you will be helping to improve the parts that still need to be fine-tuned.
• In six months you will be a... key part of the team; an autonomous contributor who knows how to teamplay. Your feedback will have helped to change the quality of what we build

🎯 How will you do it?

At the moment we are powered by a Ruby on Rails platform and a few services written in Python and Javascript hosted in AWS. The services talk to each other using REST, data is stored in PostgreSQL, and the frontend uses React.

We are a data-intensive business, so there are a lot of integrations with third-party services and financial institutions. We have a relentless drive for clean, secure and well-tested code, which shows during code reviews, and whenever a change is approved it gets deployed automatically through our zero-downtime CI/CD pipeline.

What will you need?
• At least 5 years of experience as Ruby Developer.
• Computer Engineering or related training.
• Experience with the rest of our technology stack is valuable: Javascript, React, Python, AWS...

Hiring Process
• People & Culture interview with: get to know us!
• Code challenge: show us what you can do! It won't take you more than 2 hours
• Pair programming session with our CTO: get to know how he does things and what you could learn from him
• Engineering Manager interview: you'll get to know the team a little bit
• CEO interview: so that you can meet the ultimate decision-maker

Joppy is a tech recruitment platform built for developers by developers.

✅ No CV required. Just say what you know and what you want.

✅ Anonymous profile by default.

✅ You choose who can talk to you. Companies can't write to you until you accept their offer.

✅ Only relevant offers matching your preferences. No more Javascript offers for Java developers.

✅ Get a reward if you get hired.

Keep an eye on tech job opportunities anonymously and match the job that makes you happy

jobs_results.title: Programador Ruby On Rails (Híbrido)
jobs_results.description:
DÉJANOS CONTARTE LO QUE NOS HACE GENUINE

jobs_results.description:
Tu nueva empresa

Empresa internacional con plataforma de comercio electrónico gestionando diferentes sites para clientes de todo el mundo.

Tu nuevo puesto

- Trabajarás en un nuevo proyecto de integración del CRM Salesforce en el backend en Ruby on Rails
- Estarás enfocado en el desarrollo del ecommerce sobre: procesos de compras con las API´s de proveedores, uso de gran volumen de datos, gestión administrativa de implementación de productos, pricing y data SEO.
- Ayudar a los Juniors en la extracción de peticiones de QA

Qué necesitarás para encajar con el puesto

- Contar con más de 4 años de experiencia programando en Ruby on Rails (versión superior a 5) ,SQL, EsticSearch, RSpec / Minitest
- Experto en control de versiones con GIT y procesos de QA
- Sabes como trabajar con contenedores Docker
- Conoces las implementaciones internas del Webshop u otros sistemas de backend systems y te adaptas rápido a un nuevo dominio
- El uso de arquitecturas de software y diseño de patrones son... temas importantes para ti para poder trabajar cómodo y seguro.

Qué obtendrás a cambio

- Contrato indefinido y directo con este cliente final
- Oficinas en el centro de Barcelona
- 2 días de Telework a la semana
- Los Viernes hasta las 15:00
- Salario fijo elebado (+ de 70.000 euros brutos anuales)
- Seguro médico
- Retribución flexible
- Desayunos en la Ofi
- Crédito mensual de Ticket restaurant
- Entorno de trabajo muy dinámico, colaborativo y cercano
- Compañeros nacionales e internacionales

Tu siguiente paso
